Line 1 'qowyise': '4ⱡⱡ8' read w,y,i — the crossed strokes may also be ñ. Line 3 sign after 'arpk' is H-shaped, read i?. Line 5: one hatched sign after te with a trace, read d? (te[d]ḫelowi). Father's name 'mksetẖ?l?': last sign hatched. Line 9: two dotted t-like signs after a; second may be a misdrawn m. Benediction 1 'pso?ẖe : kete' — the '/3' could be q (pqẖe). Last group 'psḫrkete' has te with a dot.
check_notes: All 17 entries placed. tmseqowi: the printed names table and Index C both show a closed 3 (s); Index C was typed tmẖe (see ref_corrections). terikloliwi (sic) in Index C kept as terikelowi from the copy (see kept_against_type).

notes: First word drawn '4ꝋ' (i joined to w) and '43': read 'wi si' as shown, likely for wosi. 'sori-' (twice): the sign before y is a 4 ligatured to r, read i (e expected). Crossed signs with a loop read ñ (lines 3, 4, 10); in tedḫlowi the crossed sign read d. tedḫlowi has one S between ḫ and o (read l; e omitted). Line 6 sign after t is 9-shaped, read ẖ?. Line 16 group: small '>' read l?, a flat dash read o?; uncertain. The 'p' in the benedictions is drawn '4ʒ' (ξ). '/3' in 'q?ekte' could be s+o. One text with continuous line numbers 1-22; labels a and b mark the two starts (wosi / wosi).
check_notes: All 35 entries placed. Labels a and b mark the two parts the indexes call 94 a (lines 1-12) and 94 b (lines 13-22); the line numbers run on, so it stays one object. Formula C: the table prints ẖolkete, the prose (part a) ẖolkte; the copy shows five signs, kept ẖolkte. The copy has a single dot between ḫmlol and ẖolkte where the table prints a divider: left as a space. mleke follows Index A and C (Index B melke).
